## Feature Description

## Problem It Solves

## Proposed Solution

How would this work in the swarm?

- **Which tier(s) are affected?** T0 / T1 / T2 / T3
- **New agent needed?** Yes / No — if yes, proposed slug:
- **New gate needed?** Yes / No
- **Breaking change?** Yes / No

## Scope Check

Before submitting, verify this feature passes the COALA Boundary Test:

- [ ] Does this serve operational engineering workflows?
- [ ] Does it reduce costs or improve execution quality?
- [ ] Does it work on both Windows and Linux?
- [ ] Can it run self-hosted?

> If any answer is "no," this feature may not belong in COALA SwarmOps core.

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches were considered and why were they rejected?
